patthana14.32:1.1: kāmāvacaraṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na kāmāvacaro dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā, tīṇi.
patthana14.32:2.1: na kāmāvacaraṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na na kāmāvacaro dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā,
patthana14.32:4.1: rūpāvacaraṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na rūpāvacaro dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā, tīṇi.
patthana14.32:5.1: na rūpāvacaraṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na na rūpāvacaro dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā.
patthana14.32:7.1: arūpāvacaraṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na arūpāvacaro dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. tīṇi.
patthana14.32:8.1: na arūpāvacaraṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na na arūpāvacaro dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā.
